## Summary

Describe the release-feed, updater metadata, or release-artifact change.

## Verification

List the commands, checksum checks, or manual checks you ran.

## Safety

- [ ] No app source code, service internals, secrets, signing credentials, or private logs are included.
- [ ] Release artifacts and updater metadata are intentional for publication.
- [ ] Source, CLI, and plugin changes are routed to the sibling source repositories instead.
